title: query_index returns 0 for contacts with identical peer_login, ambiguous position
description: ContactStore::query_index counts contacts WHERE c2.peer_login < c1.peer_login. When two contacts have the same peer_login, both return the same count (same 0-based index). Contact/queryChanges will report both new contacts at position N, causing the client to insert them at the same slot. KITH-hqrw.53 already covers the non-determinism in list(); this is the companion issue for query_index: not only is the result non-deterministic for contacts with duplicate login names, the returned index is incorrect for both. The fix requires a secondary sort key (e.g. peer_user_id) to break ties consistently in both list() and query_index().
